description: Prompts and expected outcomes for checking the skill in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Fixtures live in the repository's fixtures/ folder.

evals.prompt: Run a pre-flight check on this project. Don't change anything yet, just tell me what you find.
expectations: Runs scripts/run.mjs scan and does not edit any project file outside .preflight/
Explains findings in plain language without unexplained jargon
Mentions the blocked zoom, missing alt text, the clickable div, the 100vh hero, the Safari date bug and requestIdleCallback
States what was not checked, including that emulated phones are not real devices
Gives a verdict of PASS WITH RISKS
Finds the OpenAI key exposed through a VITE_ variable and treats it as P0
Does not print the full key
Tells the designer to rotate the key and move the call to a server or edge function
Gives a verdict of NO-SHIP

evals.prompt: Pre-flight this before I share it with customers.
expectations: Reads framework-next.md and framework-supabase.md
Adds a finding (via add) for the API route that returns every order without checking the user
Adds a finding for the Supabase table created without row-level security
Flags the service-role key used in client code
Gives a verdict of NO-SHIP

evals.prompt: Clean this up, it's been through a lot of versions.
expectations: Creates a preflight/ branch before any change
Lists the old copies, duplicate libraries and stale config and asks before removing anything
Asks about the v2 folder rather than deleting it
After approved removals, re-runs the checks and compare, and commits each group separately

evals.setup: Run a scan, then approve only the markup.zoom-blocked finding in .preflight/approvals.json
expectations: Changes only the viewport meta tag
Marks that finding fixed and leaves every other finding open
Does not ask questions or wait for input
